name: poison-message
title: The ledger stops booking: a poison message
label: Captured from Klaxon's synthetic payments system, live on Docker Compose on this Mac: synthetic data only, no real customers or money. Klaxon's own fault runner injected the fault under synthetic traffic, and Klaxon's own alert rules raised the alert from what the stack showed. At that moment, with the fault in place, this script called Klaxon's own read-only tools in place of a model: money_check and recent_deploys, as their results came back, and every log line Loki held for the four services. No model was called.

fault.name: poison-message
fault.title: The ledger stops booking: a poison message
fault.cause: a deploy of the ledger consumer that retries unreadable messages forever (BAD_EVENTS=retry), then one unreadable event from the provider (a payment.updated with its amount as a decimal string): the ledger consumer is stuck on it, and books nothing behind it
expected_symptoms: the ledger's lag climbs on every partition: one consumer reads all three, and it is stuck on that one message (head-of-line blocking); the payment confirmer keeps up
the ledger's retries climb, with 'could not book; will retry the same message' errors for one offset
the confirmer dead-letters the same event as unreadable; the ledger never does
the ledger consumer turns unhealthy: its heartbeat stops while it retries
the money check cannot settle (exit 2); without waiting, the events behind the poison look lost
fault.remedy: roll the ledger consumer back to dead-lettering: the poison goes to the dead-letter topic, the backlog drains, and the money check passes again

alert.name: BooksBehindProvider
alert.summary: Our books cannot catch up with the provider: at each of the last 2 evaluations, the money check waited 15 s and could not settle up to its cutoff. At the last one, messages up to it were not handled yet: ledger 176.

captured.command: python scripts/capture_incident.py poison-message --out incidents/poison-message --warmup-seconds 180 --record-on-failure <tmp>/poison-third-try-record.json --note 'Warm-up 180 s, not Klaxon'"'"'s 60 s: two earlier tries at 60 s stopped before any injection, because the p95 latency of POST /payments was already over 2 s on the fresh stack (Klaxon'"'"'s PaymentsLatencyHigh rule).'
captured.note: Warm-up 180 s, not Klaxon's 60 s: two earlier tries at 60 s stopped before any injection, because the p95 latency of POST /payments was already over 2 s on the fresh stack (Klaxon's PaymentsLatencyHigh rule).
captured.command_paths: paths shown relative to this repo, and a temporary folder as <tmp>
